title: Feed counters match the updated display rates
summary:
Feed counts got a quieter, adjusted display, and a community browser tool joined the project list.

The feed’s Gen / Sec display and image and text counters now use fivefold values. Load-bar thresholds still use the original rate; this changes the display, not generation speed.

The generation count badge no longer blinks or glows.

Pollinations.ai Enhancer was added to the Tools & Interfaces list and README. The community browser script offers better readability, download options, and access to generation metadata; this PR lists the tool rather than changing pollinations.ai pages.

daily.title: Pollinations.ai Enhancer listed
daily.text: Find a community browser script that improves page readability and adds download options and access to generation metadata. The project list now includes it; pollinations.ai pages themselves have not changed.
